title: AssetRef
description: A reference to a physical or logical asset owned by a tenant. Asset classes are registered centrally; the enum is open, so consumers MUST ignore unknown values rather than treat them as an error.

class.description: Registered asset class. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

id.description: Tenant-scoped asset identifier, unique within (tenant, class).

tenant.description: Deployment identifier. Duplicates the envelope `blumetenant` so the reference is self-describing off-bus.
